reasoning_evidence: No IA signed as of June 2026; typical IA-to-COD for 180 MW solar is ≥ 24 months — even an IA signed Q3 2026 puts best-case COD at Q3 2028+
Zero construction activity in any imagery frame (2024-03 through 2026-06); $0 qualified investment in TY 2024 (Form 772)
Six COD slips over 5.4 years: 2023-02-28 → current 2027-09-20, total drift 4.6 years
FIS only approved 2026-02-17 — still at an early milestone 5 years after queue entry
No financing announcement, no EPC award, no PPA found; developer (Greenfields Solar LLC) has minimal public footprint
Ch.313 limitation period start was Jan 2026 per agreement but commercial operation not achieved — agreement at risk of expiration/default
Original Ch.313 schedule called for NTP Q3 2023, completion Q4 2024 — both missed by years; investor capital still not committed as of TY 2024
